evidence.note: The phrase בְּנֵי נֹחַ identifies Shem, Ham, and Japheth as Noah’s sons.
The verse identifies Shem as Japheth’s brother and the ancestor of all Eber’s descendants.

name: שֵׁם
note: Genesis does not give a naming explanation.
summary: Shem is one of Noah’s three sons and the ancestor through whom Genesis traces the line to Abram. His name is written and pronounced like the noun for name.
